# Madhya Pradesh urban election sources

*Generated by `make state-readmes`.*

The separate urban handoff contains 170 reported 2022 winners from contemporaneous Bhopal and Indore news lists. Sex, reservation and votes are unreported and remain missing. The official current Indore council roster has 85 entries; it is kept separate from election-time winners. Neither table enters the pooled master.

See [sources, definitions and limitations](release/urban/README.md) and the [dictionary](release/urban/dictionary.csv). Original historical election-report scans remain under `raw/`.

Run `make mp-urban` to rebuild the handoff offline.
